notes: TIER 1 (direct HTTP) was sufficient and reliable throughout. robots.txt checked first: no Claude/anthropic-specific disallow present (only generic disallows for cart/checkout/account/search/policies etc.), so no policy_opt_out. Site is Shopify-backed (francfranc.com, Shopify storefront). Primary discovery method: fetched the complete site taxonomy via the Shopify storefront /collections.json endpoint, paginated (limit=250) across 13 pages until empty, yielding all 3084 published collections (id range matched the max id declared in /sitemap_collections_2.xml, confirming completeness) with exact site-reported products_count per collection - this is the authoritative qty source (method 2, structured JSON, field 'products_count' from /collections.json). Every collection's title+handle was scanned for Japanese/English seasonal keywords (Halloween/ハロウィン/pumpkin/かぼちゃ/witch/魔女/costume, Christmas/クリスマス/xmas, New Year/正月/迎春/謹賀新年/干支/初売り/年末年始/初詣/おせち/鏡開き, Valentine/バレンタイン, White Day/ホワイトデー, Setsubun/節分, Hinamatsuri/雛/雛人形, Tango no Sekku/端午/こどもの日/こいのぼり/五月人形, Tanabata/七夕/短冊/笹, Obon/お盆/盆提灯/盆踊り). Individual collection pages were spot-checked via raw HTML (H1/title tag) to confirm the SITE ITSELF (not just the URL handle) brands each page with the holiday name, per the boundary rule. Also inspected the live header hamburger menu (via browser) end-to-end: the primary 'カテゴリから探す' (Browse by Category) tree is 100% product-type based (Furniture/Appliances/Fabric/Curtains/Kitchen/Bath-Beauty/Storage/Fashion/Interior-accessories/Outdoor) with zero Event/Christmas/Halloween/New Year node, and the 'ギフトから探す' (gift-finder) page is a generic price-range/category gift hub with no holiday branding - confirming seasonal collections are reached via homepage campaign banners/search rather than the standing left-nav, which is normal for this pattern and does not disqualify them (they are still genuine, independently-linked, product-count-bearing PLPs). RESULTS: Christmas has an extensive, genuinely branded taxonomy (all H1-confirmed 'クリスマス...'): a general hub (xmas-all), Decorations-all, Objects, Candles, Snow Globes, Ornament Sets, Wreaths, Toys, Trees-all + Large/Small trees + Tree-top/skirt, Party-all + 6 party sub-facets (apron/cutlery/glass/decoration/plate-bowl-glass/cookware), a 'Small Christmas' compact-items sub-line (+ its Branch Tree sub-page), a Christmas Gift hub, and a broader catalog-wide 'event-christmas' (H1 'イベント - クリスマス') listing - kept as a separate row since its count (1329) does not match the sum/scope of the dedicated xmas-* hub and it is a distinct, independently reachable PLP (overlap is expected/normal per instructions, not treated as double-counting since neither is a null nav label - both have real independently-queried counts). EXCLUDED as duplicates: ranking-xmas-all and ranking-25-xmas-gift (identical product counts to xmas-all/25-xmas-gift respectively, same underlying listing re-sorted for a ranking widget); 25christmas-gift1/gift2 (tiny numbered 'コレクション①/②' curated look-book picks, editorial not taxonomy). Valentine's Day: valentine_day (H1 'VALENTINE'S DAY') and event-valentine (H1 'イベント - バレンタイン', broader, kept separate for the same reason as Christmas) and 26aw-vd (H1 'バレンタインアイテム'); excluded 26aw-vd_crm as a near-duplicate (same H1, count 60 vs 63) CRM-tracking mirror of 26aw-vd. New Year: newyear_crm (H1 '年末年始' = Year-end/New Year) and newyear_art (H1 '年末年始特集 | アート・オブジェ' = New Year Feature - Art & Objects), both genuinely New Year-branded PLPs. ABSENT after exhaustive check (zero title/handle matches across all 3084 collections, plus zero Halloween mention anywhere on the live homepage HTML, plus 404s tested on plausible handle guesses event-halloween/halloween-all/halloween/xmas-halloween/25halloween/26halloween): Halloween (despite Francfranc's known reputation for Halloween merchandising elsewhere/other years, no live Halloween collection exists on the site as checked 2026-09-04 - plausibly not yet launched for the season), Setsubun, Hinamatsuri, Tango no Sekku/Children's Day, Tanabata, Obon, Easter, Thanksgiving, Diwali. CONSIDERED AND EXCLUDED as out-of-scope gift-occasion (not seasonal-decor-holiday) categories per the project's Japan-specific holiday list: Respect for the Aged Day (敬老の日), and White Day. CORRECTION (orchestrator verify pass, 2026-09-04): Mother's Day (母の日) was also placed in this excluded bucket by the worker with the same reasoning, but that was wrong - rules/seasonal.md SS3 explicitly lists Mother's Day as in-scope. Verified directly and added 7 rows (see end of rows[]): the general 母の日 hub plus 5 genuinely H1-branded product-type sub-collections (Drinkware/Body Care/Beauty/Bags/Gift Sets) under the '26-mday-*' handle series, mirroring the same structural pattern already accepted for Christmas. Excluded (not added) as genuine editorial/curated gift-guide pages, matching the pattern already used to exclude 25christmas-gift1/gift2 above: mothersday-pickup (母の日におすすめ, generic 'recommended' framing), 5_selections_mothersday (explicit numbered curated picks), magazine-mothers-gift2/gift3/day5 (magazine-prefixed editorial), and 25-mothersday (prior-year duplicate of the same 'recommended products' framing as 26-mday-00, which was itself flagged MANUAL REVIEW as borderline rather than a clean include). - the 'whiteday-all' collection's own H1/title is the generic 'ギフトにおすすめ' (Recommended for gifts) with zero occurrences of ホワイトデー anywhere on the page, so the site itself does not brand it as White Day (fails the 'site itself associates it with the holiday' test); only the URL handle hints at it. No storewide sale/clearance pages (e.g. 'NEW YEAR SALE', 'BLACK FRIDAY SALE', 'GW SALE' - all with generic %-off products spanning the whole catalog) were included, per the marketing/sale-page exclusion rule. No PDPs were crawled; all quantities are the exact site-reported products_count field from the live /collections.json API.
